text.toast.downloadProgress.title: Downloading Voices of Wynn Audio
wynnvp.config.option.autoProgress.toolti: After an NPC finishes their line, it will automatically forward to the next line
wynnvp.config.option.blockCutOff.tooltip: The minimum distance in blocks that the sound will be cut off from the speaker. For some sounds a manual adjustment is set to prevent the sound not being heard
wynnvp.config.option.blockVillagerSounds: Mutes villager and related sounds while voice dialog is active, preventing them from playing over voice lines.
wynnvp.config.option.debugAndLogs.custom: Custom path to audio files. This can be a url starting with (http...) or a local folder path. Spaces are fine, and surrounding quotes or backslash-escaped spaces are accepted too.

Path to a custom sounds.json file containing dialogue-to-audio mappings. This will override the default sounds.json. Spaces are fine, and surrounding quotes or backslash-escaped spaces are accepted too.
wynnvp.config.option.debugAndLogs.highli: Should there be an aura of particles highlighting the source of the sound? This is mostly useful for debugging
wynnvp.config.option.debugAndLogs.logDia: If each time a dialogue that is encountered should be put into the vowlog.txt file
wynnvp.config.option.debugAndLogs.logOve: Print overlay-based dialogue lines (e.g. from Fruma) into the chat as they are detected. Useful for debugging the overlay dialogue system.
Log every overlay packet's extracted npc and body text to vowLog.txt. Use this to capture real packet sequences from in-game and replay them as unit tests.
wynnvp.config.option.debugAndLogs.logPla: Log a bunch of miscellaneous things about playing sounds
wynnvp.config.option.debugAndLogs.onlyLo: A setting for logDialogueLines to only log missing lines
wynnvp.config.option.debugAndLogs.useCus: If the custom audio path should be used that is defined in the next option
Enable loading dialogue mappings from a custom sounds.json file instead of the default one
wynnvp.config.option.downloadSounds.tool: If all sounds should be downloaded. Enable this if you experience high latency in audio playback
wynnvp.config.option.earlyPlayOverlay.to: Start playing dialogue as soon as a partial line matches, before the typewriter animation finishes. Disable to only play after the full line is received. Note: when voice acting is missing for a line, an early partial match may cause the wrong audio to play.
wynnvp.config.option.earlyPlayOverlayMin: Minimum number of characters a partial line must match before early audio playback is triggered. Lines shorter than this threshold will play once the full line is received instead.
wynnvp.config.option.enableReverb.toolti: Adds environmental reverb effects to NPC voices based on their location (caves, buildings, etc.)
wynnvp.config.option.nicknameOverride.to: If you use a Wynncraft Nickname, enter it here. It will be replaced alongside your real username when matching dialogue lines to audio.
wynnvp.config.option.playAllSoundsOnPlay: This will disable the stereo effect of voices.
wynnvp.config.option.playbackSpeed.toolt: Controls the speed of voice playback. 100% is normal speed, lower values slow down speech, higher values speed it up. Might introduce audio artifacts.
wynnvp.config.option.voiceVolume.tooltip: Adjusts the volume of voices played by this mod. 100% matches Minecraft's Voice/Speech volume.
